description: The developer's own domain, on THEIR Cloudflare (the topic "domain" of neblla_projects cloudflare_setup), and the mail of that domain (topic "mail"). Works with any registrar. Omit projectId for the account's. DNS (free): "add" { domain }: Neblla makes the zone on their Cloudflare, copies every record the public DNS shows (web, MX, TXT, DKIM…; every one «DNS only», as today) and compares MX, TXT, www and the apex with the public DNS. Clean: status "pending" and the two nameServers the developer puts at their registrar (the one manual step); the old web and mail keep working meanwhile. Not clean: status "mismatch" with check.diffs and no nameservers; the differences are in check.diffs; "copy" { domain } copies again, "copy" { domain, accept: true } goes on anyway only when the developer says so. "remove" { domain } (the zone stays theirs on Cloudflare). Web: "point_web" { domain, appId, confirm? }: www to the app (its custom domain, certificate by Neblla) and the apex redirected to www. Without confirm it answers what it would replace (the records serving the old web): confirm: true goes ahead with the replacement. "unpoint_web" { domain } puts those back. Registration (optional; at Cloudflare's cost, in the developer's own account, never Neblla's name): "transfer" { domain }: starts a transfer in. It needs the auth code: the answer has panelUrl, where the developer enters the code; this tool does not take it, with the steps: unlock it at the old registrar, ask for the auth code, turn DNSSEC off there, paste the code, pay the year. "register" { domain, confirm? }: buys it in THEIR Cloudflare (billable, not refundable): without confirm it answers the price; confirm only once the developer agreed to that price. Then "add" it. When Cloudflare's API cannot do it, the answer has url: the exact dashboard screen. Mail forwarding (free, no card): "mail_forward" { domain, to, from? }: from "*" (every address, the default) or one address (info) to a mailbox of the developer (to); Cloudflare emails `to` a confirmation they must click (verified). If the domain has mailboxes at another provider it is refused with domain_has_mailboxes; replaceMailboxes: true replaces them (the old MX are kept; "mail_restore" puts them back). "mail_stop" { domain, from? }. Real mailboxes (writing from info@) are not Neblla's. The actions that only look (list, registration, transfer_check, check_new, mail_status, check) are in neblla_domains_read.

accept.description: copy: go on despite the differences (the developer said so)

appId.description: point_web: the app the web shows

from.description: mail_forward / mail_stop: "*" or an address of the domain

replaceMailboxes.description: mail_forward: replace the other provider's mailboxes (the developer agreed)
